environment.description: AWS Lambda function triggered by SQS queue. The Lambda function URL is configured with AuthType=NONE, allowing any caller to invoke the function URL endpoint directly. The SQS queue policy allows sqs:SendMessage from '*'. The Lambda execution role has AmazonSQSFullAccess and allows ec2:RunInstances. No input validation on SQS message bodies. CloudWatch logs show the function processes ~200 messages/minute from various internal services.
